title: Fix StreamMetadataForm modal missing all dark mode styles
description: The StreamMetadataForm (src/components/layout/stream-metadata-form.tsx) modal is completely missing dark mode support. It renders with plain light-mode classes: bg-white, text-gray-900, text-gray-700, border-gray-200, border-gray-300 — with NO dark: variants anywhere in the component. When the app is in dark mode, this modal appears as a jarring white box with unreadable contrast. Affected elements: modal container (bg-white), header h2 (text-gray-900), all labels (text-gray-700), all inputs/textareas (border-gray-300, no dark bg/text), close button (text-gray-400), footer border (border-gray-200), hint text (text-gray-400). Fix: Add dark: variants consistent with the rest of the app — dark:bg-gray-800, dark:text-gray-100, dark:border-gray-600/700, dark:text-gray-300 for labels, dark:bg-gray-700 for inputs. The SipocForm component already shows the correct pattern.
